techAndSupplyChainLockin.mechanism: Mercedes-Benz transferred 50% equity of the iconic micro-car brand 'smart' into a joint venture with Geely. Vehicle engineering, battery packaging, and manufacturing were relocated 100% to Geely's SEA platform in China, while Mercedes retained only exterior/interior styling styling duties.
techAndSupplyChainLockin.strategicConsequence: Complete de-industrialization of Smart production in Europe (Hambach plant sold to Ineos); European brand identity fully dependent on Chinese hardware architecture and software stack.

techAndSupplyChainLockin.mechanism: For the next-generation Mercedes MMA platform (new CLA-Class compact luxury sedan), Mercedes-Benz entered contracts to source 4-cylinder hybrid gasoline engines developed and manufactured in partnership with Horse Powertrain (50:50 Geely-Renault JV with Saudi Aramco minority equity).
techAndSupplyChainLockin.strategicConsequence: Heart of Mercedes compact vehicle powertrain outsourced to Chinese-controlled joint venture; loss of European ICE/hybrid core manufacturing competency.

techAndSupplyChainLockin.project: Qianli Auto / Momenta Autonomous Driving & Telemetry Cloud
techAndSupplyChainLockin.partner: Momenta / Qianli (Geely Tech Ecosystem & Tencent Cloud)
techAndSupplyChainLockin.productionSite: Integrated in Chinese Mercedes Navigation & L2+/L3 Urban AD
techAndSupplyChainLockin.mechanism: To compete with Chinese EV tech, Mercedes partnered with Chinese autonomous driving startup Momenta (backed by SAIC, Geely, Tencent) and localized Chinese data centers for urban AD navigation and high-definition mapping.
techAndSupplyChainLockin.strategicConsequence: Vehicle telemetry, camera sensors, and driver behavioral data routed through Chinese domestic servers, falling under China's National Intelligence Law (Art. 7) and Data Security Law.

partyCommittees.lawReference: Company Law of the PRC (Art. 19 / 2023 Revision Art. 170) & CCP Constitution
partyCommittees.mandate: Requires any company in China (including foreign JVs like Beijing Benz) with more than 3 CCP members to establish a Party Committee. Party secretary must participate in major corporate decision-making before board review.
partyCommittees.implication: Beijing Benz and domestic Tier-1 suppliers are legally bound to align hiring, production pacing, and strategic direction with the Chinese Communist Party's 5-Year National Industrial Plans.

nationalIntelligenceLaw.lawReference: National Intelligence Law of the PRC (2017) - Article 7
nationalIntelligenceLaw.statuteQuote: 'Any organization or citizen shall support, assist, and cooperate with state intelligence work in accordance with the law, and keep confidential state intelligence work secrets known to them.'
nationalIntelligenceLaw.implication: If Chinese security agencies request automotive sensor logs, location tracking data, or source code from Qianli, Geely, or Beijing Benz, refusal is illegal under Chinese criminal law, creating massive cross-border espionage and GDPR compliance risks.

dataSecurityLaw.lawReference: Data Security Law (2021) & Cross-Border Data Transfer Regulations
dataSecurityLaw.statuteQuote: 'Critical data and personal information generated in the PRC must be stored domestically and undergo CAC security assessment before outbound transfer.'
dataSecurityLaw.implication: Western OEMs are legally prohibited from transferring Chinese R&D data or crash telemetry back to German headquarters without state censorship approval, effectively creating a severed, air-gapped technological split.
